title: Midjourney goes from generating cat images to full-body ultrasound scans
brief: Midjourney unveiled The Midjourney Scanner, an ultrasound-based full-body imaging device using a ring of sensors to capture cross-sectional images of muscle, fat, bone, and organs with image quality aimed at MRI-level performance. The hardware product marks Midjourney's expansion beyond AI image generation, with CEO David Holz also announcing plans to open a San Francisco spa offering the scanning service.
